description: This course aims to expose students to the human-centered principles of designing and building virtual reality (VR) and augmented reality (AR) applications. Students will learn about the fundamentals of VR and AR, human perceptions of reality, and the design patterns and guidelines for user interactions within VR/AR applications. Students will gain hands on experience building VR/AR applications applying these interaction principles.
prerequisite: If undertaking an Undergraduate Degree THEN ( must have completed CS3240 at a grade of at least D AND ( must have completed 1 of MA1301/MA1301X at a grade of at least D OR ( must have completed 06 MATHEMATICS at a grade of at least E AND must be H2)))
prerequisiteRule: PROGRAM_TYPES IF_IN Undergraduate Degree THEN (COURSES CS3240:D AND (COURSES (1) MA1301:D, MA1301X:D OR (SUBJECTS (1) 06:E AND SPECIAL MUST_BE_IN "SUBJECT_LEVEL=H2")))
title: Interaction Design for Virtual and Augmented Reality
